ul.li: to discuss relationship dynamics and personality traits;
to explore advanced C1 vocabulary for describing interpersonal relationships;
to analyze whether contrasting personalities complement each other.

cosy-vocabulary-item.definition: combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize the qualities of each other
conflict or animosity caused by a clash of wills
reserved and focused on internal thoughts

cosy-teacher-notes.title: Stage aim
cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic of attraction between contrasting personality types and establish lesson goals.
Do you believe that opposites attract, or do birds of a feather flock together? Today we will analyze advanced vocabulary around relationships and character traits.

cosy-slide.title: Discussion: Attraction Dynamics
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Discuss the following questions with your teacher

ol.li: In your experience, do people with opposite temperaments make better partners? Why or why not?
What traits in a person do you find most complementary to your own?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Ask CCQs: If two traits are complementary, do they fight each other or complete each other?

cosy-slide.title: Controlled Practice: Personality Terms
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Select the correct term to complete each statement

cosy-slide.title: Speaking & Case Study
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Analyze the case study and record your response
